app_tagline: Immediate access to critical emergency resources when every second counts
hero_subtitle: Instantly discover nearby hospitals, ambulances, police stations, fire services, 24/7 pharmacies, blood banks, and disaster shelters.
categories_subtitle: Select a category to quickly filter resources closest to your current location
cat_hospitals_desc: Trauma centers, emergency wards & tertiary care hospitals
cat_ambulances_desc: 108 emergency response, ICU transport & life support
cat_police_desc: Law enforcement, highway patrol & safety assistance
cat_fire_desc: Fire suppression, rescue operations & hazard control
cat_blood_banks_desc: Component separation, transfusion & emergency blood units
cat_shelters_desc: Disaster relief centers, storm shelters & civic relief posts
location_denied: Location permission denied. Enter your location manually below.
location_enter_placeholder: Enter city, area or landmark (e.g. Katpadi, Vellore, CMC)
search_placeholder: Search by name, address, or medical service...
no_results_title: No resources found in this radius
no_results_desc: Try expanding your search radius, selecting 'All Services', or searching for a different area.
step_1_desc: Share your current GPS location or type your town/landmark to pinpoint nearby assistance.
step_2_desc: Filter between hospitals, 108 ambulances, police, fire, pharmacies, blood banks, or shelters.
step_3_desc: Call dispatchers directly with one touch and launch turn-by-turn navigation via OpenStreetMap/Google Maps.
offline_notice: Offline Mode: Showing cached emergency contacts. Live distance search requires an active connection.
disclaimer_text: If you or someone else is in immediate danger, dial National Emergency 112, Medical 108, or Police 100 immediately. This platform is an educational resource finder created as an Innovative Project (IIP) at Vellore Institute of Technology (VIT).
footer_vit_credits: Vellore Institute of Technology (VIT) • Innovative Project (IIP)
contact_subtitle: Report an outdated resource, suggest a new emergency service, or reach the VIT IIP team.
form_success: Thank you! Your feedback has been received and recorded.
